name: Exolix Point 7
body:
***MAKE SURE YOU HAVE YOUR SEEDS***

# Overview

This is patch release  **v4.1.7 "Exolix"** fixing QR Code Amount & updating translations (yes Weblate)

**Warning:** Uninstalling the app will delete your wallets on the device! Use the backup function to backup your wallets - you will need the CrAzYpass (aka "Restore Password") in order to open backed-up wallets - also in other apps.

Also available from [Monerujo F-Droid Repo](https://f-droid.monerujo.io/fdroid/repo/).

# Changes since 4.1.6 (previous release)
* FIX: QR Code amount
* Weblate (finally)
* Fix node port input field 

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m2049r/xmrwallet/compare/v4.1.6...v4.1.7
